summary: Season 8 is concluding and transitioning into Season 9, prompting players to finalize their gear carryover through Cross-Boundary Storage and the Piece of Treasury forge. Despite the removal of flat main stats from gear drops, standard dungeon farming remains largely unrewarding due to low Mythic+ drop rates and heavy RNG on substats. The creator demonstrates that purchasing all 100 Mythic+ Equipment Option Chests from the Crisis Rally Shop is far more effective for obtaining usable pieces than spending stamina on dungeons. He rolls several chest and glove pieces targeting HP% and high Critical Damage to prepare for an upcoming Radiance/Aura team centered around Talethia.

teams.note: A slower team setup designed to cast frequent ultimate skills rather than nuking the boss, maximizing buff crystal triggers and challenge chest drop procs.

meta_changes: Flat primary stats (HP, ATK, DEF) were removed from gear drops, but secondary roll variance still makes direct dungeon farming inefficient.
Crisis Rally Mythic+ Equipment Option Chests have become the primary reliable source for acquiring high-end Mythic+ seasonal gear.
tips: Prioritize buying all 100 Mythic+ Equipment Option Chests from the Crisis Rally Shop over purchasing stamina bread.
Do not waste resources heavily farming standard gear dungeons expecting top-tier Mythic+ rolls, as drop rates for usable gear are extremely low.
Select and temper high Critical Damage pieces (such as Precise Carnage Armor+ or Curse of the Fallen Gloves+) to preserve in Cross-Boundary Storage for the next season.
In dungeon Challenge Modes, utilize teams that cycle multiple ultimates to trigger modifier crystals and increase chest drop rates.
title: WE NEED MORE CHANGES!! The Gear Drops Are Still Not Good Enough!? Dragonheir: Silent Gods
